subject: history_social
passage: Archaeologists working at sites of the Indus Valley Civilization, in present-day Pakistan and northwestern India, have found thousands of small square seals carved from a soft stone called steatite. The most common image on these seals, a one-horned animal that researchers often call a ______ usually appears above a short line of Indus script. Because the script has never been deciphered, scholars still debate exactly how the seals were used.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: The phrase "a one-horned animal that researchers often call a unicorn" is extra information describing "The most common image." It opens with a comma, so it must close with a comma before the verb "appears."
explanation.A: Incorrect. Extra information that opens with a comma must close with a comma; a dash doesn't match the opening mark.
explanation.B: Incorrect. A semicolon can't separate the subject "The most common image" from its verb "appears."
explanation.C: Incorrect. Without a closing comma, the extra information is never set off and runs straight into the verb "appears."
explanation.D: Correct. The comma closes the extra information, so the subject "The most common image" connects cleanly to its verb "appears."
